about: Business check — one frozen assessment per symbol: is the company doing what it promised? Read by ui/business.js for display ONLY. No stop, trim, weight, leverage or ticket logic reads this file. To change a verdict, add a NEW assessment (move the current one into history[] unchanged) — never edit a past one, so forward paper tests can grade what was known at the time.

IREN.thesis: AI cloud capacity gets built, accepted by customers and turned into recognized revenue, funded without heavy dilution.
IREN.summary: Demand up, delivery late, financing still open.
IREN.assessor: Claude (Jack's chat), from LAB-009 + the Nov 5 issuer release

milestones.name: Revenue conversion
milestones.metric: AI Cloud revenue $200M in Q1 FY27, up 182% from $71M

milestones.name: Delivery
milestones.metric: >$4B ARR target moved from year-end 2026 to Jan 31 2027, may extend to end of Feb

milestones.name: Financing & dilution
milestones.metric: $4B ARR program stated fully funded; $6B of FY27 capex still to be financed; net debt $4.4B

IREN.changed: Nov 5 print: revenue beat and backlog up 22% to $20.3B, but the >$4B ARR date slipped 1–2 months (customer-requested design change + supplier timing). ARR is a run-rate target, not recognized revenue.
invalidators: >$4B ARR not operating by Feb 28 2027, or customer acceptance fails
AI Cloud revenue falls quarter over quarter at the Q2 FY27 print
The $6B FY27 capex is funded mainly by new shares rather than contracted prepayments or GPU debt
A major customer contract is cut or cancelled

nextReview.trigger: ARR target date — delivery / customer acceptance update; then the Q2 FY27 print
